'''Milkened tuber''' was a [[Planet/Legends|root]] [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetable]]. After the internal [[Seed/Legends|seed]]-husk was removed, it was included in many gourmet dishes.<ref name="CSWE" /> In the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it was used by the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Gormaanda/Legends|Gormaanda]] in a recipe called "[[Glowblue Noodles and Chav]]." The recipe called for one milkened tuber that was peeled, quartered lengthways, and seeded. When preparing the recipe, Gormaanda instructed to quarter the milkened tuber crossways and to halve each quarter again when the seed-husk was reached to keep it at a uniform size. Gormaanda gave the recipe in an edition of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] on the date [[22 BBY/Legends|13:4:4]].<ref name="News">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|life/1344_2.html|Gormaanda's Culinary Corner: Glowblue Noodles & Chav}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Milkened tuber was first mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 50|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #50'']], an [[in-universe]] issue of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="News" /> It was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1430412533337182209|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=that was one of mine.|archivedate=20210825094315}}</ref> and published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] on [[April 4]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN50 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6308795|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=Mavrick889|date=2002-04-04|time=3:16 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref>
